data.narrative: Student demonstrated deep security and systems engineering competence throughout Module 04. In Step 1 (Context) and Step 2 (Decide), the student established clear traffic separation between unauthenticated public redirects and authenticated tenant administration. In Step 3 (Break), the student deterministically reproduced the Pydantic ValidationError caused by the API_KEY_PRIMARY alias mismatch, distinguishing configuration failures from database and network socket issues. In Step 4 (Fix), the student implemented multi-alias resolution using Pydantic AliasChoices, supporting API_KEY_PRIMARY, API_KEY_A, and api_key_a with zero breaking changes. In Step 5 (Verify), all 13 security and regression checks passed, verifying 401 unauthenticated protection, strict tenant isolation, 404 anti-enumeration, sliding-window rate limiting (30/min write, 120/min redirect) with Retry-After headers, and background click persistence.
